body:
Founder real-time: 'in the IDUNA BACKOFFICE i need an interface for the training keys it needs to reveal them to me like an admin in carepyre can summon the email password out of the void.' Investigated CarePyre's own reveal-password feature (IDUNA_PRO/internal/mailaccounts) first: that works because mailbox passwords are stored reversibly AES-256-GCM-encrypted at rest. IDUNA's own agent secrets are NOT -- internal/store hashes them one-way (SHA-256(agentID+plaintext)), by original deliberate design (cmd/create-admin-agent's own doc comment: 'prints the plaintext secret once -- it's never retrievable again'). Found the actual, sole plaintext record: cmd/bootstrap writes every provisioned/rotated secret to var/agent-secrets.env (export IDUNA_SECRET_<NAME>=<value>), the same file training scripts (SHANKPIT's scripts/rl_registry.py, colab_train.py) already source to authenticate against IDUNA for pushing/pulling RL checkpoints from a Colab runtime -- this IS the 'training key' the founder meant. New internal/agentsecrets package (ReadAll/Lookup/WriteMerged) is a careful, tested port of cmd/bootstrap's own merge-safe write logic (deliberately NOT refactoring bootstrap itself to import it -- a named tradeoff, bootstrap is a fragile one-shot tool with its own prior incident history, S141-04, where a naive overwrite once destroyed several agents' only recorded plaintext; kept as a separate, equally-careful copy rather than risking that tool under time pressure). New 'Reveal secret' button on /admin/agents (POST, not GET, to keep a plaintext secret out of browser history/referrer/proxy logs) reads it back. Real, honest limitation surfaced explicitly in the UI, not glossed over: this only works for a secret provisioned via cmd/bootstrap or rotated via this same admin UI since this feature landed -- rotating a secret via /admin/agents/{id}/secret now ALSO writes the new plaintext into agent-secrets.env (best-effort, never blocks the real rotation), so newly-rotated secrets stay revealable going forward, but an older secret rotated before this existed genuinely can't be recovered, and the 404 says so with an actionable next step (rotate it). The reveal action itself is audit-logged (iduna:admin.agent.secret_reveal), never the plaintext value, matching this handler's own established 'never log the raw credential' discipline (secret_rotate's own existing event does the same). New internal/agentsecrets tests (5, including a direct regression test replaying the exact S141-04 incident shape) + 4 new admin_test.go cases (not-configured 404, no-recorded-plaintext 404, real reveal + audit event, rotate-then-reveal round trip). go build/vet/test ./... all clean.

⚓ ☃
title: Back Office: reveal training keys (agent M2M secrets), like CarePyre's mailbox-password reveal
